results.content: Illinois State Budget Fiscal Year 2026 July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026. The Illinois Constitution of 1970 requires the Governor to prepare and submit a state budget to the General Assembly for the upcoming fiscal year. For the budgeted funds, revenue estimates include the beginning fund balance, revenues to be received during the budgeted year, and revenues due to the State as of June 30, to be collected in the two-month lapse period following the budgeted year. In addition, the State Budget Law requires that all revenue estimates for the coming fiscal year be based on revenues established in current law or passed by the General Assembly and signed by the Governor at the time the budget is presented. capital purposes .Illinois State Budget Fiscal Year 2026 624 Glossary.
